style_summary: Extreme near-to-far sports photography interlocked with giant white oblique type, a dark vignetted gradient lit by a bright colored haze, and close-up gear or contact points that express each sport's force and direction.

environment_variables.SOURCE_CONTENT_TO_AVOID: Runtime source identities and content to replace
environment_variables.SUBJECT: Concrete athlete, sport, action and unmarked clothing
environment_variables.FOCAL_DETAIL: Physically connected near-camera contact point or equipment

style_fidelity_anchors: [CORE] Photographic athletic action uses an extreme near-to-far scale jump: one physically connected piece of equipment or body part dominates the foreground while the athlete recedes into depth.
[CORE] Monumental white heavyweight oblique sans-serif typography cuts through the composition; the athlete occludes selected letter areas without destroying the exact headline.
[CORE] A near-black edge field opens into a luminous single-hue atmospheric band behind the action, producing sharp white-type contrast and dark sculptural human form.
[CORE] Directional photographic motion softness and colored atmospheric streaks carry the force vector while the critical contact point or equipment retains selective detail.

[FLEX] Let each sport determine the spatial structure: circular banked wheel, vertical gripping tension, lateral water crossing, or needle-like fencing thrust; avoid one interchangeable athlete layout.
[FLEX] Place, rotate, stagger or stretch the type around the movement; protect complete headline comprehension while allowing scale, selected edge cropping, and controlled overlap.
[FLEX] Choose one dominant hue per case, with dark and pale related tones; hues may vary across the family.
[FLEX] Recompose subject, title and negative space independently for portrait and landscape, preserving the same case concept rather than cropping the other ratio.
source_content_to_avoid: The source Nike swoosh, Nike wordmark, JUST DO IT slogan and any recognizable sportswear brand logo.
The PEGASUS42 or PEGASUS 42 model wording and the reference advertising paragraph.
The white running shoe with a teal swoosh as a giant foreground product.
The exact front-facing male runner, lifted knee, grey long-sleeve top and black shorts combination.
The source arrangement of fragmented PEG, S42 and giant brand letters; do not trace its composition.

visual_deconstruction.reference_observations: The supplied portrait uses a huge near-camera shoe, a receding runner, dark green-to-mint glow, monumental slanted white type and broad foreground speed softness. Small white copy acts as a calm secondary layer. These describe the source; exact product, brand, pose and type positions are not retained.
visual_deconstruction.reusable_system: Oppose an enlarged near contact point with a receding human figure and giant planar lettering; align haze and letter force with the case-specific movement.

composition.hierarchy: Near contact point or equipment first, athlete and movement second, monumental headline sharing the hero scale, small series label and single supporting line last.
composition.depth: Three overlapping planes: atmospheric field, white headline, photographic action, with selected foreground streaks passing in front.
composition.ratio_adaptation: Each case includes separate 9:16 and 16:9 plans. Rebalance scale and negative space rather than center-cropping.

typography.headline: Heavy geometric grotesk, uppercase, oblique or dynamically rotated, white, monumental, exactly spelled and readable as complete words despite selected occlusion.
typography.secondary: Small but clearly readable white sans-serif, slightly oblique optional; restrained case series and one supporting line; no body paragraph.
typography.copy_policy: Render only the three exact case strings, each once; line breaks are flexible but letters and punctuation are not.

color_palette.relationship: Near-black edges 35-50%, one luminous case hue 20-35%, white typography and lit photographic surfaces 20-35%; estimates are compositional guidance.

image_treatment.texture: Clean commercial photographic compositing with no added paper grain or halftone. Keep microtexture on the focal tire, chalked skin, wet hand or woven fencing glove; use broad soft motion streaks in the direction of travel and luminous mist only around passing surfaces. Preserve intentional peripheral blur and dark facial detail instead of sharpening everything.
image_treatment.lighting: Sculptural hard/soft mixed lighting: dark athlete with bright rim and light on the near contact surface; light and haze share the case hue.

design_rules: Keep the foreground object physically connected to a coherent athlete and valid sporting action.
White lettering must function as a large spatial plane interacting with the movement.
Limit finished artwork to the three exact case text strings; do not add logos, pseudocopy or punctuation.
Maintain clean separation between sharp focal evidence and intentional directional softness.
Treat each case concept and each aspect ratio as a designed composition.
do: Check anatomy, contact and equipment continuity at full size.
Keep the headline readable and white type dominant at thumbnail scale.
Preserve atmospheric softness and useful quiet space.
Use sport-specific force geometry to distinguish the four cases.
avoid: Copying the source shoe, swoosh, slogan or runner pose.
Four interchangeable centered figures with only color or props changed.
Random particles, paper grain, fake film damage or decorative HUD graphics.
Overblurring the contact point, malformed hands, floating equipment or illegible headline.
negative_prompt: Nike logo, swoosh, PEGASUS42, JUST DO IT, original running-shoe hero, logo-like symbols, extra text, extra punctuation, watermark, QR code, duplicate limbs, disconnected equipment, fused fingers, fake sharpness, halftone, paper grain, random particles, busy stadium, border, poster mockup, small timid headline, unreadable headline, generic repeated layout

values.SUBJECT: An adult female track cyclist in a plain black skinsuit and unmarked aerodynamic helmet, banking a real track bicycle into a high-speed turn.
values.FOCAL_DETAIL: The near front wheel of the bicycle forms a huge oblique elliptical rim in the lower foreground. Fine rubber and carbon detail remain visible along the sharp leading section, with rotational blur on other sections. The frame, fork, handlebar and rider remain physically coherent.
values.DESIGN_DIRECTION: Use the near wheel as a curved spatial gate. The rider and back wheel recede above it; the letter masses cut diagonally behind the rider and can be glimpsed through the spokes. Portrait: the wheel anchors the lower two fifths and the banked rider climbs up the central diagonal. Landscape: the wheel fills the right foreground while the rider sweeps toward it from upper left; preserve a generous upper-left title zone. This is the dynamism of a banked circular turn, not a runner with a swapped prop.
values.PALETTE: Petroleum black, luminous icy cyan and silver-white; a soft cyan velocity band behind the banked wheel.

values.SUBJECT: An adult female rock climber in a plain sleeveless graphite top and dark trousers, hanging below one gripping hand on a steep overhanging rock face.
values.FOCAL_DETAIL: An extremely close chalked hand closes anatomically around one pale sandstone edge at the top-right foreground. The fingers wrap the rock with clear believable contact. The attached arm and suspended climber recede down and left; a second visible hand stabilizes lower on the rock.
values.DESIGN_DIRECTION: Turn grip and gravity into a taut upward counter-diagonal. The rock lip and hand form the near anchor; the body stretches away into dark space. White type stands like a load-bearing slab behind the arm, with light chalk haze along the downward tension path. Portrait: the large grip sits high with the body descending below, title occupying the left and lower space. Landscape: the rock lip enters upper right and the athlete spans toward lower middle; leave bold type on the left. Do not turn the climber into a forward-running pose.
values.PALETTE: Obsidian brown, glowing ochre and pale warm chalk; warm atmospheric falloff behind the suspended body.

values.SUBJECT: An adult male competitive swimmer in an unmarked dark swim cap and goggles, photographed at the waterline in a powerful freestyle stroke.
values.FOCAL_DETAIL: One extended wet hand and forearm reach close to the lens just as they pierce the surface; all five fingers are anatomically formed and held together naturally. The swimmer body trails back through a sculpted narrow spray wake. Water surface refraction remains physically legible.
values.DESIGN_DIRECTION: Make the waterline a crossing plane that slices through the typographic field. The leading hand is the large foreground wedge and the swimmer follows a lateral diagonal, while the white headline occupies luminous air above and water-dark negative space below without losing letters. Portrait: a steep diagonal forearm connects a near low hand to the swimmer higher and farther away. Landscape: emphasize a long lateral stroke with near hand on the left and the swimmer receding right, type arranged in two purposeful levels. Use fluid continuity rather than shoe-like product framing.
values.PALETTE: Midnight navy, electric cobalt and translucent ice blue; reflected white surface light across the central water band.

values.SUBJECT: An adult fencer in an unmarked ivory fencing jacket, breeches, protective glove and mesh mask, executing a technically coherent single-sword lunge.
values.FOCAL_DETAIL: The bell guard and gloved weapon hand are close to the camera; the single thin metal blade travels diagonally across the foreground with a clearly visible blunt sporting tip. The attached extended arm connects to the masked torso; rear arm is separate and balanced.
values.DESIGN_DIRECTION: Use one fine blade to interrupt an enormous slab of white type: needle against mass. The foreground guard is moderately enlarged, and a long low lunge recedes behind it. Warm linear motion haze follows the attack while fabric and wire mesh stay selectively crisp. Portrait: a steep blade diagonal crosses open upper space, near guard at middle-left and athlete extending to lower-right. Landscape: sword and extended arm create a long left-to-right vector, with fencer on the right and near guard toward left; let the giant title fill the upper open field. Keep the sport precise and technical, not a fantasy sword duel.
values.PALETTE: Near-black oxblood, vermilion red and warm ivory; a luminous red band follows the thrust through the dark field.
